source: Free unauthenticated OpenRouter model and endpoint listings (https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models and /api/v1/models/{id}/endpoints), read on 2026-08-31 for the sixteen registered v6 exact routes. No API key, Keychain entry, private seed, or completion endpoint was used. Supersedes the 2026-08-16 authenticated snapshot for the withdrawn eight-model cohort. Recheck every rate immediately before any spend decision. Four rows re-read on 2026-09-01 for the route-and-cohort amendment (z-ai/glm-5.3-flash on DeepInfra fp8 (moved from Fireworks 2026-09-01T19:40Z), minimax/minimax-m3 on ModelRun fp4, qwen/qwen3.8-flash on Alibaba, nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b on DigitalOcean).
pricing_scope: Conservative planning rates for the sixteen registered exact routes. These rates are catalog metadata, not route acceptance: no route is accepted and no paid smoke, panel, or publication execution is authorized.

planning_assumptions.basis: Frozen pre-data planning inputs for results/analysis/sota-v6-panel-cost-estimate.json. Input is the v6 hard observation ceiling (8,000) rather than the ~6,500 target, so the estimate stays conservative. Output is the full 4,096-token ceiling on every call, which is a per-call worst case, not an expectation. Internal reasoning tokens are planned at zero because the v6 ceiling includes reasoning: a mandatory-reasoning row spends part of the same 4,096 tokens on reasoning rather than adding tokens on top of it.

runtime_observations.source: Mean provider API seconds per decision from each registered model's accepted strict smoke artifact listed in config/sota_v5_smoke_manifest.json (four decisions per smoke, serialized calls).

public_metadata_limitations: Rates and endpoint health are volatile point-in-time public metadata and must be rechecked immediately before spend.
Unauthenticated metadata does not establish account access, successful inference, reasoning behaviour, JSON behaviour, request-cap behaviour, or authoritative usage cost.

Gemini 3.7 Flash and Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite publish a separate internal-reasoning rate. It is recorded for auditability; the plan bills reasoning inside the 4,096-token ceiling, so no reasoning tokens are added on top.

The four mandatory-reasoning rows are planned at zero extra reasoning tokens because the 4,096-token ceiling includes them. If an accepted smoke shows a provider billing reasoning tokens on top of the ceiling rather than inside it, this snapshot and the estimate must be regenerated before panel authorization.

The cost artifact was regenerated on 2026-09-01 from the sixteen accepted smoke artifacts (runtime observations above); token planning bounds are unchanged. Regenerate again if pricing, routes, or prompts change before the panel.

paid_smoke_authorization.granted_because: Owner-authorized 2026-09-01 re-run under the fixed one-paid-call rule; final infrastructure retry after attempt 1 hit DigitalOcean HTTP 429 (partially billed, reconciled), taken after an eighteen-minute cool-down.
paid_smoke_authorization.outcome: excluded-at-infrastructure-attempt-limit: DigitalOcean HTTP 429 on both attempts; no other route for nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b meets the frozen eligibility rule
